description: Search PubMed biomedical literature via NCBI E-utilities (esearch + esummary + efetch): PMID, title, authors, journal, publication date, volume/issue/pages, DOI, PMCID, publication types; abstracts only on request (abstracts=true, off by default since they may be publisher-copyrighted; structured sections kept). Full PubMed query syntax ([MeSH], [Author], AND/OR), relevance or newest-first, publication-date range. Server-wide 3 req/s NCBI limit respected. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pubmed-search

abstracts.description: Include abstracts (default false; one extra NCBI call; abstracts may be publisher-copyrighted)

query.description: PubMed query (alias q); field tags like [MeSH], [au], [ti] allowed

name: pubmed_search
title: Pubmed Search
